assets.title: Lamellae
assets.author: FurryScaly
assets.observations_roman_urdu: Ventral foot close-up; five radiating digits, expanded oval-ish adhesive regions, many transverse lamellar rows, granular plantar/wrist scales. Pads are not round suction cups. Some terminal curved projections visible; digit-index and exact joint morphology cannot be mapped from this single view.
assets.species_note: Commons description only gecko; do not silently call this tokay. Morphology context only, not tokay anatomical blueprint.

assets.observations_roman_urdu: Left orange toe pad curls back at distal tip, yellow setae detach sequentially, red separation-front arrow moves toward proximal side. Right grey gecko-shoe restricts bending; limb lift starts opposite front. This is an authored schematic, not live motion/anatomical measurement.
